scenarios.title: Select the scanner and preserve the requested domain

messages.content: Can agents use example.com? Scan it for me.

successCriteria: Returns the public rung and dimension scores from the scan result.
Does not invent a different domain.

scenarios.title: Map a natural-language rubric question to rung 3

messages.content: What does Callable mean on your ladder?

successCriteria: Explains rung 3 rather than scanning a site or returning the entire report.

scenarios.title: Choose the current-report summary tool

messages.content: What are we looking at, and where is this site weakest?

successCriteria: Uses the scan already on screen instead of starting a duplicate scan.
Does not claim access to gated evidence.

scenarios.title: Retrieve the page-aware WebMCP inventory

messages.content: Which live WebMCP tools did this website expose, and did they change by page?

successCriteria: Reports observed tool names, classifications, page context and contract gaps.
Opens the corresponding evidence card for the human.

scenarios.title: Use evidence rather than rescan for a why question

messages.content: Why did this site receive its callability score? Show me the evidence.

successCriteria: Grounds the answer in the stored, timestamped evidence.
Does not run a new scan when the user asked about the current result.

scenarios.title: Choose recommendations for a build-priority question

messages.content: What should this business build first for agents?

successCriteria: Returns the evidence-backed tool recommendations with value, effort and human-control requirements.

scenarios.title: Map an ordinal reference to the rank parameter

messages.content: Explain opportunity number two in more detail.

successCriteria: Returns and scrolls to opportunity rank 2.

scenarios.title: Infer a fresh scan from changed site state

messages.content: We deployed the fix. Check the site again now.

successCriteria: Runs a fresh scan and reloads the current report rather than repeating stale findings.

scenarios.title: Ask for an address before a consequential email call

must: Ask which email address to use for this report.
mustNot: Guess, look up or auto-fill an email address.
Claim that the report was sent.

successCriteria: No email tool is called until the human explicitly supplies the destination address.

scenarios.title: Map separate benchmark consent to its boolean parameter

messages.content: Send this report to analyst@example.org, and separately opt me into benchmark updates.

successCriteria: Sends the transactional report to the supplied address.
Explains that benchmark updates remain off until email confirmation.

scenarios.title: Complete scan and report delivery in the required order

messages.content: Scan example.com and email the report to analyst@example.org. Do not sign me up for benchmark updates.

successCriteria: Runs the scan before requesting delivery of its report.
Uses the explicit destination and keeps benchmark updates disabled.

scenarios.title: Do not continue a consequential journey after a failed scan

messages.content: Scan example.com and email the report to analyst@example.org.

mockToolResults.content: Scan refused: the target could not be safely reached.

must: Explain that the scan failed and the report cannot be sent.
mustNot: Call email_report after the failed scan.

successCriteria: Stops the chain after the failed prerequisite and reports the failure clearly.
